## Dark mode

The header toggle stores the choice under `acme:theme` in `localStorage`
and falls back to `prefers-color-scheme` on the first visit.
a3f9c2d1-7b4e-4c8a-9e21-5d6f8a0b1c2e:too.rationale: Documenting the storage key so nobody wonders where the preference lives.
Define the dark palette as CSS variables so the toggle only has to flip a data attribute on <html>.
Set data-theme in a blocking inline script before React hydrates, so the first paint already has the right theme and there is no flash.
